tables.heading_context: ## Engineering Bridge: Paradigm Shifts in Platform Transitions
rows: Ptolemaic astronomy; puzzle-solving within the paradigm
COBOL/mainframe: transactions, batch jobs, JCL scripts — all solvable within the paradigm
Orbital precession calculations don't quite fit
Web scale, user growth, 24/7 availability — mainframe paradigm strains but teams add auxiliary hypotheses (bigger boxes, more batch windows)
Geocentric model requires ever more complex epicycles
The auxiliary hypotheses (add more RAM, tune the DB) stop working; incident rate rises; nobody knows how to scale further
Client-server → web → cloud-native: the new paradigm doesn't just solve the old problems differently, it reframes which problems matter
"Mass" means different things in Newtonian vs. Einsteinian physics
"Transaction" in a COBOL system vs. a distributed microservices system is not the same concept; ACID semantics do not translate to eventual consistency — the vocabularies are incommensurable
A more refined model of theory change
The most radical critique of scientific method
